answer.book: Printed Latin treatise (Iohannes de Spina, Paris 1591) on divine providence, dedicated to Henry IV, with a dedication, an argument, a prefatory ode, the main treatise in books and sections, and an alphabetical index; the sheet gives no printed table of contents and no numbered series to count from.
